name: Solara Softline T-Shirt
description: A lightweight cotton T-shirt designed with a smooth, brushed finish that feels soft against the skin. It features a slightly curved hem and a relaxed fit for effortless everyday wear.

name: Northbay Classic Crew Tee
description: A structured crewneck T-shirt with reinforced stitching along the collar and sleeves. Built for durability while maintaining a clean, minimalist look.

name: Virelli Draped V-Neck Tee
description: A flowy T-shirt with a deep V-neckline and a fluid silhouette. The fabric drapes elegantly, making it suitable for both casual and elevated outfits.

name: Elmsworth Buttoned Blouse
description: A semi-formal blouse with a soft collar and hidden button placket. Designed with subtle tailoring at the waist for a flattering, office-ready fit.

name: Liora Silk Touch Blouse
description: A smooth, satin-like blouse that reflects light subtly. It includes cuffed sleeves and a relaxed neckline, ideal for dressy occasions.

name: Maribel Floral Breeze Blouse
description: A loose-fitting blouse with an all-over floral print and airy fabric. The slightly puffed sleeves add a gentle, romantic style.

name: Ardent Ribbed Tank Top
description: A fitted tank top made from stretchy ribbed fabric. It contours the body comfortably and works well layered or worn on its own.

name: Zephyra Airflow Tank
description: A breathable tank top featuring micro-vented fabric for enhanced airflow. Designed for warm climates or active days.

name: Cove Linen Tank Top
description: A relaxed-fit tank made from lightweight linen. Its natural texture and loose cut give it a laid-back, coastal feel.

name: Ironvale Straight-Leg Jeans
description: Classic denim jeans with a straight-leg cut and medium wash. Designed for long-lasting wear with a timeless silhouette.

name: Highcrest Sculpt Skinny Jeans
description: Slim-fit jeans with stretch-enhanced fabric that adapts to movement. They provide a sleek, close-to-body fit without restricting comfort.

name: Alder Tailored Slacks
description: Polished slacks with a tapered leg and pressed front crease. Ideal for professional settings, offering a sharp and refined appearance.

name: Meridian Wide-Leg Trousers
description: Flowy trousers with a high waist and wide-leg design. They create a bold, elegant shape while allowing ease of movement.

name: Brookfield Relaxed Fit Trousers
description: Casual trousers with a slightly loose cut and soft fabric. Designed for comfort while maintaining a clean, structured look.

name: Everknit Classic Cardigan
description: A mid-weight knit cardigan with a button-down front and ribbed cuffs. Versatile enough to layer over both casual and dressy outfits.

name: Haloform Drape Cardigan
description: An open-front cardigan with a fluid, draped silhouette. Designed to fall naturally along the body for a relaxed, modern style.
